parameters.name: CreatorID
parameters.description: The ID of the user who created the machine group.

parameters.name: MachineGroupIDs
parameters.description: The machine group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the machine group.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order.

- `Asc`: Sorts the results in ascending order.

- `Desc`: Sorts the results in descending order.

parameters.name: OrderInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the purchase order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: PaymentDuration
parameters.description: The payment duration. If `PaymentDurationUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60.

parameters.name: PaymentDurationUnit
parameters.description: The billing duration unit of the machine group.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupID
parameters.description: The globally unique ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The instance status. `Creating`: The instance is being created. `Ready`: The instance is running. `Expiring`: The instance is expiring. `Expired`: The instance has expired. `Stopping`: The instance is being stopped. `Stopped`: The instance is stopped.
